featured_reviews.name: Mini Bhatia
featured_reviews.review_text:
My journey with chronic pain began around 2012–13, following persistent back issues and multiple falls. Over time, the condition gradually worsened, and in 2023, after another fall, I was diagnosed with osteoporosis. Pain in my knee, hip, and back became increasingly severe, eventually affecting even the simplest daily activities.

By August 2024, mobility had reduced significantly, and I was almost bedridden. While surgery was advised, it became clear that rebuilding strength was essential for a successful recovery. At this stage, I began aqua therapy at Aqua Center at Prabhadevi.

The initial phase was challenging, with even basic movements causing discomfort due to widespread muscle tightness and trigger points. However, with consistent guidance and a structured program combining aqua therapy, land-based rehabilitation, and targeted pain-relief techniques, gradual but meaningful improvement was achieved.

In December, I underwent a hip replacement surgery. Following recovery, rehabilitation was resumed with regularity and focus. The clinical expertise, personalised attention, and continuity of care at Aqua Center at Prabhadevi played a vital role in regaining mobility and confidence.

Today, there is a marked improvement in strength, balance, and overall movement. Walking is comfortable again, and there is a renewed sense of control over the body. Beyond physical recovery, the process has helped correct long-standing movement patterns and restore functional independence.

Aqua therapy, along with guided physiotherapy, has been an integral part of this recovery journey. It is highly recommended for individuals managing chronic pain or preparing for and recovering from surgery, as it offers a safe, effective, and truly transformative path to rehabilitation.

A special note of gratitude to Sanya, Pravalika, and Vaibhavi for their dedication, care, and unwavering support throughout this journey. Their expertise and encouragement have made a meaningful difference at every stage of recovery.
Mini Bhatia

Most families wait years before making the first call. Not because they do not care. Because they are unsure whether what they are witnessing is serious enough to require residential treatment. When withdrawal symptoms — trembling, sweating, or intense anxiety — appear each time the person tries to stop, medical supervision is no longer optional. When daily responsibilities at work and within the family have been meaningfully disrupted, the condition has moved beyond what willpower alone can manage. When a co-occurring mental health condition such as depression or anxiety is present alongside the addiction, integrated clinical care is not a preference — it is a clinical requirement.

At Elite Care Rehabilitation Centre, Titwala (near Kalyan), residential treatment is delivered under the direct oversight of Dr. Harish Bedekar, MD Psychiatrist. featured_reviews.review_text: I’m extremely grateful for the care and guidance I received from my physiotherapist. After my ACL surgery, the recovery process felt challenging, but their expertise, patience, and encouragement helped me make steady progress every week. They always took the time to explain each exercise, monitor my recovery closely, and adjust my rehabilitation plan when needed. Thanks to their support, I’ve regained confidence in my movement and continue to improve my strength and range of motion. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, dedicated, and caring physiotherapist.

featured_reviews.name: Linette Martis
featured_reviews.review_text: As a Canadian visiting India for a short time, I had the chance to see a physiotherapist (Dr. Clinton Pereira of Grit Physio) and I can confidently say it was an exceptional experience. The level of care and expertise I received was truly outstanding.  Clinton took the time to understand my issue in detail and provided treatment that was both effective and personalized. He didn’t just focus on relieving my symptoms but worked on addressing the root cause of my discomfort. Each session was well-structured, combing hands-on techniques, guided exercises, and clear explanations that helped me understand my recovery process. He also provided helpful advice and exercises to continue at home, ensuring long-term benefits. I noticed a significant improvement in my pain and mobility within just a few sessions. His professionalism, Knowledge, and genuine commitment to helping me recover inspired me a lot. I’m very grateful for the care I received and would highly recommend this physiotherapist to anyone in need of quality treatment. Thank you Dr. Clinton for such an amazing experience.

featured_reviews.name: Alson

featured_reviews.name: jyothi shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dr Clinton has been an absolute game-changer in my recovery journey from knee pain.
When I first came in, walking was little strenuous .  He conducted a thorough assessment and clearly explained the source of my knee pain and the structured plan we would follow.
The initial phase focused entirely on pain relief and restoring basic mobility. The results were fantastic; within a few weeks, the chronic ache was nearly gone. I appreciated how he used a combination of manual therapy and gentle exercises, always checking in to ensure I was comfortable with the process.
Now, we are in the strengthening and fitness phase. The exercises are challenging but tailored perfectly to my current fitness level. I'm focusing on building the muscles around my knees and improving my overall strength and cardiovascular health. I can already feel the difference—I have more energy, my knees feel stable, and I am gaining confidence in my body's abilities again.
What sets  Dr Clinton apart is his clear communication, encouraging attitude, and personalized approach. I never felt rushed, and he provided  excellent guidance on home exercises to manage my recovery between sessions. I highly recommend him to anyone seeking relief from pain and looking to make a lasting investment in their physical fitness and well-being.

featured_reviews.name: sneha lahori
featured_reviews.review_text: I had pain in the heel when I went to Grit physiotherapy. Dr Unnati through various exercises in her seasions helped reduce the pain. I would definitely recommend Grit Physiotherapy. Best wishes to the entire team.

featured_reviews.name: Jennifer
featured_reviews.review_text:
I went to Dr Clinton in a pretty bad state, suffering from a severe muscle spasm. While he soon set me right, he identified the problem and we started also working on strengthening the muscles. I had also lost considerable muscle mass over the years and have started working on this with Dr Clinton . And - well - I’ve seen very positive results in my strength , stamina, agility,  posture in the last couple of months that I’ve joined GRIT. Dr Clinton is patient and answers every question. I like the fact that he actually makes notes(logs)  after every session and is thorough and sincere . I found the pricing very competitive and the location is also good . The doctors secretary is also very adept . Till date I’ve not been kept waiting for doctor - appointments are given efficiently and in case if any stray case of delay , I have been informed well in advance .

I wish GRIT - Dr Clinton and his team the very best . We need more physiotherapists like him.

featured_reviews.name: Shraddha Wadhare
featured_reviews.review_text: Grit helped me gain confidence and build strength through all the rehab exercises that were given to me. The team members are fantastic and have a vast knowledge of injuries and how to manage them. I had recently injured my back during an incorrect lifting form in the gym which made me very nervous to get back to strength training. Despite going to numerous physios, I was still unsure what was going on with my body. Upon visiting Grit, all my queries were answered and I am happy with how my body is responding to the rehab program. I will continue with the program and recommend them to anybody looking to get better rehab results! Thank you

featured_reviews.name: Nirav Ravindra Naik
featured_reviews.review_text:
I cannot recommend Chinton and Pallavi at Grit Physio enough. I came in struggling with lower back pain that was affecting my daily routine. From the very first assessment, their approach was incredibly thorough.

Chinton didn't just treat the symptoms; he took the time to explain the root cause of my pain and created a tailored recovery plan. The targeted exercises has made a massive difference. I feel stronger and more mobile than I have in a long time. If you are looking for physiotherapists who genuinely care and get results, this is the place to go.
